title: A federated learning method for data privacy protection in connected vehicles

pse.problem: Data privacy concerns in a data-centralized approach for training intelligent services in Internet of Vehicles due to potential data leakage
pse.solution_function: Federated learning method for secure sharing and model optimization of Internet of Vehicles data, utilizing a central server, roadside units, and target vehicles. The method involves data classification based on SHAP model interpretation, differential privacy perturbation, local training, and parameter exchange.
pse.solution_structure: Central server, multiple roadside units, target vehicles (with networking functions) within the communication coverage of each roadside unit
pse.solution_implementation: 1. Central server initializes global model parameters, global iteration number, and target accuracy. 2. Central server sends model training request to all roadside units along with initialization details. 3. Each roadside unit requests participating vehicles (target vehicles), selects a suitable vehicle based on a preset strategy, and sends model training request and initialization details to the selected vehicle. 4. Each target vehicle classifies data based on contribution value using SHAP model interpretation, applies differential privacy perturbation to data with high contribution values, uses back propagation algorithm for local training, optimizes local model parameters, and sends parameter updates and loss values to corresponding roadside unit.
pse.effect: Ensures privacy protection of shared data in Internet of Vehicles by implementing a secure federated learning method
